messages:
kai: Hydra rack EAP update — NDA is in, partner asked for a short embargo. Need to lock shipping ETA, telemetry plan, and bench window. @lina can you confirm kernel build target and telemetry keys? Also which model baseline do we want to run?

lina: Confirmed NDA received from @hydra_jess. Shipping ETA looks like Tue 2025-07-15 per logistics. Need SSH + KMS key access and IPMI creds. Suggest baseline: redwood/llama2-13b-q4f16 (quant profile v2).

sam: Sounds good. Plan: run latency sweep + 99p tail, then mlperf-style throughput curves. We should capture power telemetry during the runs — ask Hydra to enable IPMI and the power-sensor stream. Also need S3 creds to push logs.

kai: Proposed bench window: Mon 2025-07-14 through Tue 2025-07-22 (flex to extend one day). If partners can only ship on 7/15 we can start node-level soak + kernel tuning the 14th.

lina: Runbook snippet (draft):
```
# checkout model + build
git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks.git
cd benchmarks/hydra
git checkout stable/llama2-13b-q4f16
redwood runtime build --target=hydra-rack --kernels=auto

# run latency sweep
redwood bench run --model llama2-13b-q4f16 --mode=latency --seq-len=128 --concurrency=1..32 --out=gs://redwood-bench/hydra/eap/
```
Need to add KMS usage snippet once we get keys.

sam: I'll create a console dashboard: cost/latency/power traces + per-route token breakdown. Can you confirm the telemetry stream endpoint and port? We'll need port 9100 open and the forwarder credentials.

rachel_pm: NDA + embargo note uploaded to Vault and shared with Legal (cc'd). Partner asked for a 90-day embargo on publishing benchmarks. I've also uploaded an initial partner checklist to /vault/hydra/eap/checklist.md. I'll confirm final ship date today and chase IPMI creds.

kai: Actions: lina -> kernel + telemetry keys by Fri 2025-07-11; sam -> dashboard + log path; rachel -> confirm ship date + embargo ack. Also: @hydra_jess please confirm IPMI, S3 write, and whether partner can expose power telemetry.

lina: One more: we need to pin the model commit hash and quant profile in the run metadata, otherwise results won't be reproducible. I'll add a pre-run verification step to the runbook.

sam: +1 on pinning. I'll add a small validation job that verifies the KV cache behavior and end-to-end latency before main runs.

ops-bot: reservation: bench-cluster-hydra reserved from 2025-07-14T08:00Z to 2025-07-22T20:00Z (id: res-78233).

kai: Great — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short calendar invite and include partner contacts. If anything slips on keys/shipping, flag here asap. :thumbsup:
